tagline.en_US: Host a Mumble voice chat server with TCP and UDP client connectivity. The official image persists its SQLite database and configuration in /data; the SuperUser password is generated at install time.

description.en_US: Mumble Server is an open-source voice chat server designed for low-latency, high-quality audio communication. It manages connected clients, channels, and encrypted voice streams for connected users. It provides self-hosted group voice infrastructure for communities and teams.
